March 26

On Sir John Vanbrugh—Poet and Architect

By Abel Evans (1679–1737)

Sir John Vanbrugh was an architect, whose heavy and cumbrous style gave rise to this epitaph. He died on March 26, 1726.
L
IE
 heavy on him, earth! for he
Laid many a heavy load on thee.
